channel.title: BlogPost by Bogus
channel.description: Indie for indie: notes from a solo indie maker who builds with AI agents.

item.title: Why my READMEs put English first and Thai in its own file
item.description: Many Thai repos open with Thai and put English at the bottom, or leave it out. I do the reverse: English README first, Thai as a separate full file. Here is why.

item.title: Five AIs, one missing space: a Thai verbatim test
item.description: Three of five AIs rebuilt a Thai-English text exactly from a word-by-word prompt. Two dropped one space between Thai words.

item.title: Indie for indie: why this blog exists
item.description: A solo maker with no budget explains how AI agents became the team, and what this blog will share.

item.title: Never trust "not found" from an agent
item.description: Why I run a second check on every negative result before an agent reports it.

item.title: How a 1.1 MB offline Thai intent router works
item.description: TER-AI's router reads one Thai or Thai-English message with typos and returns one of 15 intents in well under a millisecond on a CPU. No GPU, no network, no dependencies. Here is the whole pipeline.
